CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_income_request_digest(p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pg_catalog.encode(
    extensions.digest(
      pg_catalog.convert_to(p_payload::text, 'UTF8'),
      'sha256'
    ),
    'hex'
  )
$function$
